entries.title: Maven cannot resolve the declared enforcer plugin version
entries.root_cause: The POM declares maven-enforcer-plugin version 3.5.9, which is not published in Maven Central. Correct the plugin version in the POM.

entries.title: Dispatch window assertion fails
entries.root_cause: The dispatch window calculation returns an inclusive end time while the test expects the exclusive boundary. Correct the boundary calculation.

entries.title: Maven cannot resolve an internal plugin
entries.root_cause: The internal beacon-audit Maven plugin is not in Central because the workflow omits the company plugin repository from its Maven settings. Configure the plugin repository in the workflow's settings file.
entries.differs_from_earlier: Like e1, Maven reports PluginResolutionException, but this plugin is internal and needs repository configuration rather than a corrected version.

entries.title: Declared enforcer plugin version remains unavailable
entries.root_cause: The POM declares maven-enforcer-plugin version 3.5.9, which is not published in Maven Central. Correct the plugin version in the POM.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later pull request uses a different runner and Maven command; the same unresolved plugin version stops the build.
